blocks.text: Employees must submit expense reports through the expense management system within 30 days of incurring the expense. Receipts are required for all individual expenses exceeding $25.

Expense reports totaling under $500 are approved by the employee's direct manager within 5 business days. Reports totaling $500 to $5,000 require VP-level approval. Reports exceeding $5,000 require CFO approval.
Expenses incurred in foreign currencies must be converted to USD by Finance using the exchange rate on the date of purchase before the approval routing begins.
Approved expense reports are processed for reimbursement within 10 business days of final approval.

messages.text: Finance update: foreign currency conversion will now use the exchange rate on the date of submission rather than the date of purchase, effective for all reports submitted after March 1.
